1445-4871-6277-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-7272.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

720-1806-2034-3025.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-3025.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

512-1336-2872.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-2872.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-2872.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2577-6495-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6495-6763-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-6495-6763-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3901-5166-7839.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
3901-5166-7839.description:
Deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
Smaug and Wrathful Red Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating at least one Treasure token.
Resolve the Wrathful Red Dragon trigger, causing Smaug to deal damage to any non-Dragon target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.

654-5900-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
654-5900-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability triggers, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

1534-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
1534-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Twincast's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Twincast targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve a copy of Twincast, copying Twincast targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 4.

3532-5078-6289-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
292-3693-7803.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7803.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

4186-6890-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6890-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

4522-6891-6892-7746.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
4522-6891-6892-7746.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Rose triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1874-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2351-4460-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-4460-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1376-1978-5776.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.

628-2511-7217.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

527-1115-1409.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

654-2034-3470-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Lotus Cobra and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Repeat.

967-1308-2292-3809-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1003-2034-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

141-313-997.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-997.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

643-4338-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2105-3204-4364-6633.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4364-6633.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3534-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3534-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1003-1329-2178-5330.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-5330.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

64-1987-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Warden of the Eye.
When Revolutionist and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1479-3147-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-4677.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

147-5900-6001--69.description:
Cast Megaton's Fate by paying {5}{R}, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Holding priority, activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Megaton's Fate, with the copy targeting the indestructible artifact.
Resolve the copy of Megaton's Fate, failing to destroy the artifact due to it being indestructible, and creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

628-1477-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-1477-5490.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

3259-3986-4412.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control any number of creatures with power 6 or greater including Battle Cry Goblin.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3986-4412.description:
Declare Battle Cry Goblin, the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and any number of other creatures as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Goblin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1633-2060-3231-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

2-1651-2397-4306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four devotion to any color.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four.
2-1651-2397-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four, this combo nets infinite mana.

579-1812-3525-3793.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-1812-3525-3793.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

1379-1558-3450.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least five poison counters.
1379-1558-3450.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Phyrexian Swarmlord triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Phyrexian Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Phyrexian Infects, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6-5089-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-5089-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-5089-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
